items.title: 2.3.2 Ionization energy aur energy levels (electronic shells) ka rishta (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.3.2, printed pages 27-29, with Quick Check 2.2 and answers.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif shells ke electrons mein sab se bara farq un ki energy ka hai. Atom ke electrons ki energies tajurbe (experiment) se naap kar hum us ki electronic configuration jaan sakte hain. Yeh kaam ionization energies naap kar hota hai.
Ionization energy woh energy hai jo gas halat ke atom se ek electron nikalne ke liye chahiye. Is se electronic configuration do tarah jaanchi jati hai:

items: Ek hi element ki successive (ek ke baad ek) ionization energies
Mukhtalif elements ki first (pehli) ionization energies

blocks.text: i) Ek hi element ki successive ionization energies
Kisi element ke atom se us ke electrons ek ek kar ke nikalein aur har electron ke liye lagne wali energy naapein:

Electrons nikalte jayein jab tak sirf nucleus reh jaye. Energies ke is silsile (sequence) ko successive ionization energies kehte hain. Yeh saaf dikhati hain ke nucleus ke gird electrons shells mein kaise rakhe hain.

Magnesium (12 electrons) ki misal lein. Pehla, doosra, teesra... electron nikalne ki energy naap kar graph banayein (Figure 2.4). Energy har baar barhti hai, kyun ke hum bahar wale (valence) shell se andar wale shells ki taraf jaate hain. Pehle do electrons sab se bahar wale shell se nikalte hain aur kam energy lete hain. Teesra electron nikalte waqt energy mein bara izafa (jump) hota hai, kyun ke ab electron us shell se nikalna hai jo nucleus ke bohat qareeb hai. Agle saat electrons doosre shell se nikalte hain aur energy ahista ahista (gradually) barhti hai. Gyarhwan aur barhwan electron nikalte waqt is se bhi kahin bara jump aata hai, kyun ke yeh nucleus ke bilkul saath wale pehle (innermost) shell se aate hain. Yun poore graph mein do bare jumps hain, jo is baat ka achha saboot hain ke magnesium ke electrons teen alag shells (2, 8, 2) mein hain.

blocks.alt: Magnesium ke liye nikale gaye electrons ki tadaad (1 se 12) ke muqable log10 ionization energy ka graph, Mg ke shells (2, 8 aur 2 electrons) ke khaake ke saath. Electrons 1 aur 2 (teesra shell) neeche hain; electron 3 se pehle bari chhalang (2nd Jump); electrons 3 se 10 (doosra shell) ahista barhte hain; electrons 11 aur 12 (pehla shell) se pehle aur bari chhalang (1st Jump).
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4: Mg ki successive ionization energies ka plot (kitab ki Figure 2.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.4 mein har point ek khaana aage khiska hua chhapa hai (pehla point 2 par). Sahi: magnesium ki baara ionization energies electron number 1 se 12 par aati hain, jaisa upar ki drawing mein hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph mein har nishan ek electron nikalne ki energy hai (log₁₀ scale par). Pehle do electrons (teesra shell) aasani se nikalte hain. Teesre electron se pehle bara jump hai (kitab isay 2nd Jump kehti hai), kyun ke woh doosre shell se aata hai. Phir aath electrons ahista barhti energy se nikalte hain, aur aakhri do (pehla shell) ek aur bare jump (1st Jump) ke baad. Do jumps = teen shells (2, 8, 2).
ii) Mukhtalif atoms ki first ionization energies
Doosra tareeqa yeh dekhna hai ke elements ki first ionization energy atomic number ke saath kaise badalti hai. Figure 2.5 pehle 88 elements ka graph dikhati hai.

items: Sab ionization energies strongly endothermic hain (energy leti hain): electron ko atom se alag karne ke liye energy deni parti hai.

Group mein neeche jaate hue, maslan helium se neon se argon, ya lithium se sodium se potassium, ionization energy kam hoti hai. Atom jitna bara, electron nikalna utna aasaan. Wajah: group mein neeche shells barhte hain aur nucleus ki valence electrons par pakar (hold) kamzor hoti hai.

Period mein aage (left se right) jaate hue ionization energy aam taur par barhti hai. Har period mein group 1 ke alkali metals ki sab se kam aur noble gases ki sab se zyada hoti hai. Wajah: period mein shell number wahi rehta hai, proton number barhta hai aur electrons usi shell mein aate hain, is liye nucleus valence electrons ko zyada zor se kheenchta hai.

blocks.alt: Pehle 88 anasir ki pehli ionization energy (0 se 2500 kJ fi mol) aur atomic number ka graph, Z = 10, 18, 36, 54 aur 86 par lakeeron aur periods ke naamon ke saath. Noble gases He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe aur Rn chotiyan hain aur alkali metals Li, Na, K, Rb aur Cs gehraiyan; har period mein energy barhti hai aur group mein neeche chotiyan neechi hoti jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Pehle 88 anasir ki ionization energies aur atomic number ka plot (kitab ki Figure 2.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.5 mein 'Period 5' ka label chhapne se reh gaya hai. Upar ki drawing mein Z = 37 se 54 ke liye 'Period 5' likha gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har period mein graph alkali metal (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs) ke neeche wale point se shuru ho kar noble gas (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn) ki choti (peak) tak charhta hai. Group mein neeche chotiyan bhi neeche aati jati hain, kyun ke atom bara hota jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Aluminium ki successive ionization energies 580, 1815, 2740 aur 11,600 kJ/mol hain. Yeh barhti kyun hain, aur teesri aur chauthi ke darmiyan itna bara jump kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Har agla electron ek zyada positive ion se nikalta hai jo baqi electrons ko zyada zor se pakarta hai, is liye energy barhti hai. Pehle teen electrons teesre (bahar wale) shell se aate hain. Chautha electron doosre shell se nikalna hai jo nucleus ke bohat qareeb hai, is liye 2740 se 11,600 ka bara jump aata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Yeh equations likhein: (i) calcium ki 1st ionisation energy (ii) potassium ki 3rd (iii) lithium ki 2nd (iv) sulfur ki 5th.
blocks.explanation: (i) Ca(g) → Ca⁺(g) + e⁻. (ii) K²⁺(g) → K³⁺(g) + e⁻. (iii) Li⁺(g) → Li²⁺(g) + e⁻. (iv) S⁴⁺(g) → S⁵⁺(g) + e⁻. Har nth ionisation mein (n − 1)+ ion se ek electron nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Aluminium (Z = 13) ki successive ionisation energies ka log₁₀ graph (y-axis) aur nikale gaye electrons (x-axis) ka khaaka banayein.
blocks.explanation: Aluminium 2, 8, 3 hai. Pehle teen points neeche aur ahista barhte hain (teesra shell). Chauthe electron par bara jump, phir 4 se 11 tak aath points ahista barhte hain (doosra shell). Barhwein electron par is se bhi bara jump, aur 12 aur 13 sab se oopar (pehla shell).

blocks.prompt: c) Table ke elements I se IV mein se kaun sa (i) reactive metal (ii) reactive non-metal (iii) noble gas aur (iv) AX₂ halide banane wala metal hai?
blocks.explanation: (i) II: pehli energy bohat kam (520) aur doosri mein bara jump (7300), yani ek hi bahar wala electron: reactive metal. (ii) IV: pehli energy zyada (1680) aur koi bara jump nahi: reactive non-metal. (iii) I: pehli energy sab se zyada (2372): noble gas. (iv) III: do bahar wale electrons munasib energy (900, 1760) par nikalte hain, is liye A²⁺ bana kar AX₂ deta hai.

items: Successive ionization energies barhti jaati hain; jahan naya andar wala shell shuru ho wahan bara jump aata hai. Magnesium ke do jumps teen shells (2, 8, 2) dikhate hain.
First ionization energy group mein neeche kam hoti hai (zyada shells, kamzor pakar) aur period mein barhti hai (wahi shell, zyada protons): alkali metals sab se kam, noble gases sab se zyada.
